::: {#def-covariate .theorem}
## Covariate

The vector of all mutually [equivalent](#def-equivalence) variables. Writing $X_{ki}$ for the $k^{th}$ construct on the $i^{th}$ observational unit, $\mathbf V$ can be stated as the matrix of its covariates:

$$
\mathbf V = \big[\, X_{ki} \,\big], \qquad k \in [1,K],\ i \in [1,n],
$$

$$
\mathbf V \in \mathbb R^{n \times K}, \qquad \mathbf X_k \in \mathbb R^{n}.
$$
:::
